name: DeepSeek
description: Read-only DeepSeek access: the account's catalogue of available DeepSeek Coder and Chat models. Sending a chat completion is a billable POST against the account's usage, so it is modelled as write:true and HITL-gated rather than fired here; this is an OpenAI-compatible template child of the openai/groq/mistral connector shape, and the viral cost-disruptor brand.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List the DeepSeek Coder and Chat models available to this API key

tools.name: chat_completion
tools.description: Send a chat completion to a DeepSeek-hosted model. This spends the account's token usage, so it is HITL-gated and never fired by the shape-proof harness (write:true means blind proof always SKIPs it; a real credential would also need --include-writes)

model.description: DeepSeek model id to route to (e.g. deepseek-chat, deepseek-reasoner), from list_models

needs_review: NO LIVE CREDENTIAL AT AUTHORING TIME: this spec is shape-proved blind only. LIVE_PROVEN needs one real sk- key against /models, a zero-spend authed read per the coverage-gap plan.

base_url is the bare DeepSeek host (no /v1 segment): DeepSeek's own docs serve /models and /chat/completions directly off https://api.deepseek.com, confirmed live during authoring (dummy-key probe returned a structured 401 at /models, not a 404).

AUTH_WALL EXPECTED, NOT SHAPE_PROVEN: DeepSeek answers every path (real or bogus control) with the byte-identical 'Authentication Fails' 401 when the key is invalid, so the auth wall sits in front of routing; the path rests on tools_source documentary provenance, same as PagerDuty in the harness's own worked example.
TEMPLATE CHILD: this spec inherits the openrouter.connector.json Authorization: Bearer shape near-verbatim, per the coverage-gap plan's template-child list.

chat_completion is the only write:true tool: it is modelled for completeness but deliberately carries no _probe and is skipped by the shape-proof harness by default (writes_not_included), and even with --include-writes it only fires if the test call already proved an auth gate.
